The first-article procedure SELECTS ITS BENCH VOLTAGES FROM THESE FLOORS, so a floor that moves without it sends a technician to a pack voltage where the release image's permission is not what the step claims.  All three gridded floors must be PRESENT, formatted from the computed values; no UNFENCED line about an accessory/rail/retention floor may quote a different one; and the paragraph forbidding a relaxed build must name all three constants, including the retention constant D-791 added.
